paper_title: PaLM: Scaling Language Modeling with Pathways

claims.statement: PaLM 540B achieves a Model FLOPs Utilization (MFU) of 46.2% (including self-attention) and a hardware FLOPs utilization of 57.8%, with an average training throughput of 238.3K tokens/sec at a batch size of 2048.

evidence.quote: In comparison, PaLM 540B achieves an average training throughput of 238.3K tokens/sec at the batch size of 2048.
The MFU of PaLM 540B is 45.7% without self-attention or 46.2% with it. Our analytically computed hardware FLOPs utilization, which includes rematerialization FLOPs, is 57.8%.
